services.desc: Illinois Holocaust Museum’s Speakers Bureau of Holocaust Survivors and their descendants offers an opportunity for educators, organizations, civic groups, and others to request event speakers. Hearing directly from a Holocaust Survivor or child/grandchild of a Survivor can leave a lasting impact and has been shown to build empathy and inspire action. Our Museum staff, including educators and leadership, are available to speak at conferences and other events to promote the Museum and Holocaust education. We welcome inquiries from all.
